rubric.role_summary: Senior electrical engineering role architecting, designing, validating, and bringing neurotech consumer hardware electrical systems into production.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior electrical engineering role architecting, designing, validating, and bringing neurotech consumer hardware electrical systems into production.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 5+ years of experience in electrical or hardware engineering.
- Experience shipping at least one consumer electronics product.
- Experience designing multi-layer PCBs.
- Understanding of analog and mixed-signal circuit design.
- Experience designing or integrating DC-DC converters and power management circuits.
- Experience with high-speed interfaces such as USB, Quad-SPI, MIPI, DDR, or similar.
- Hands-on experience with board bring-up, debugging, and lab validation.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience shipping compact or wearable consumer electronics devices.
- Experience designing wearable or body-worn devices with tight power, size, and thermal constraints.
- Experience with Altium Designer or equivalent PCB tools.
- Experience supporting EVT, DVT, and PVT builds and ramping hardware to mass production.
- Experience designing manufacturing test fixtures or automated test systems.
- Familiarity with thermal analysis for compact electronics.
- Experience with embedded firmware development (C/C++).
- Experience with Python for lab automation or instrumentation control.
- Familiarity with EMI/EMC pre-compliance testing and mitigation.
- Deeper power electronics experience including converter loss analysis, control loop analysis, and compensation design.
- Experience designing high-density, multi-layer PCBs with controlled impedance and fine-pitch components.
- Experience implementing system power architecture for battery-powered products.
- Understanding of signal integrity and power integrity in high-density electronic systems.
- Experience working cross-functionally in fast-paced product development environments.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): San Francisco Bay Area, California. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Onsite work is based in one of these areas.
